sentencepiece.token_count_comparison: SentencePiece pieces versus cl100k tokens only; different tokenizers, no GPT/Gemini vocabulary modification or production savings claim.
sentencepiece.custom_text_evaluation: Implemented locally in dashboard/API; exact reconstruction and both count systems returned; answer quality/meaning not evaluated.

saved_json_recalculation.reproducibility: Benchmark and token-count results were rerun in this environment. Reproducible only for these fixed data, package versions, and tokenizer encodings; no cross-version/cross-platform guarantee.

hardcoded_simulated_or_unmeasured: English benchmark questions and q01-q10 intent alignment are authored templates, not a naturally sampled corpus.
The 440 noisy variants are deterministic synthetic perturbations; only 110 controls correspond to curated draft prompts.
No native-speaker linguistic review or human bilingual translation audit has occurred.
The interactive native-language sentence optimizer is available, but this audit did not establish semantic equivalence.
The dashboard recomputes data at runtime rather than loading saved JSON. Compared values matched in this run; saved JSON can become stale after source/dependency changes.
Transliteration savings refer only to input string token counts under cl100k and must not be interpreted as translation quality or model cost savings.
